purpose: Machine-readable contract for research experiments and listening outcomes. Inspired by Lab evidence/learning patterns without duplicating Lab authority.

authority.rule: weaker evidence never outranks stronger evidence

required_fields.subsystem: pitch-correction | eq | synthesis | sampling | dynamics | nonlinear | modulation | routing | spatial | capture | sequencing | soundspace | wordmath | other
required_fields.status: HYPOTHESIS | SYNTHETIC | MEASURED | LISTENED | VERIFIED | DEMOTED | RETIRED
required_fields.artifacts: paths, hashes, renders, scripts, settings, logs, or commit refs needed to reproduce
required_fields.metrics: engineering measurements; may be empty for listening-only outcomes
required_fields.listening: blind/level-matched labels, listener identity or anonymous id, and conditions when available
required_fields.failure_modes: known negative cases, regressions, or conditions where the claim does not hold
required_fields.proof_strength: 0.0-1.0 confidence in the evidence quality, not musical preference

proof_guidance.0.0-0.2: idea, anecdote, weak or irreproducible observation
proof_guidance.0.2-0.4: synthetic or incomplete evidence; useful for hypothesis generation only
proof_guidance.0.4-0.7: reproducible engineering evidence with appropriate baselines
proof_guidance.0.7-0.9: repeated engineering evidence plus controlled real-audio or listening support
proof_guidance.0.9-1.0: multiple independent/repeated validations with strong provenance; still not absolute truth

learning_gate.rule: Only VERIFIED evidence may change durable product guidance automatically. SYNTHETIC/MEASURED/LISTENED evidence may propose changes but must not silently rewrite architecture truth.
learning_gate.stale_rule: Old evidence remains provenance but should be rechecked when algorithms, product code, test corpus, or external baselines materially change.
learning_gate.negative_results: Failures and demotions are first-class evidence and must remain discoverable enough to prevent rediscovery.

example.claim: Projected bounded correction prevents accepted actions from worsening the chosen objective under the tested corpus.
failure_modes: objective may not correlate with preference
